site: Northwoods Cafe at Fox River Mall
about: Fox River Mall in Appleton hosts its second annual Breakfast with Santa in the Northwoods Cafe on Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 8:30 to 10 AM. Proceeds benefit Habitat for Humanity of the Greater Fox Cities.
Santa makes a grand entrance, and families get a breakfast from IHOP, coffee and cake pops from Starbucks, a visit from a princess, craft tables and one-on-one time with Santa.
Tickets are $8 each and children 2 and under are free.
Bring your proof of purchase.

about: The 1844 Table & Mash in downtown Kenosha serves a festive family brunch with a visit from Santa Claus on Sunday, December 6, and Sunday, December 13, 2026, from 9 AM to 2 PM. The buffet has scrambled eggs, bacon, sausage, breakfast pizzas, pastries, fresh fruit and an omelet station, plus Grinch pancakes and a dessert station for kids.
Adults are $24.95, kids 4 to 12 are $19.95 and kids under 3 are free.
Reservations are required.
